units.name: Religious Volunteers
units.description: Religious Volunteers have throwing spear and shield. Warband. May have large shield (+2) and be Riding Camels (_1). May be stubborn (+2). (no longer Warband) at a cost of eight points per base

units.name: Tribal Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have a shield and either sling, javelins or bow. Inferior Fighters. Skirmishers. May have Throwing spear (+1)

units.description: Elite Bulgar Horse Archers have a light armour, bow and shield. Nomad Cavalry. There must be at least on unit of Horse Archers if ther are any Bulgar noble cavalry in the army.. Superior Shooters. Nomad Cavalry. They may have light armour (+1), spear (+1) and shield (+1). They may be fielded as skirmishers.

units.description: Bulgar Horse Archers have a bow and shield. Nomad Cavalry. There must be at least on unit of Horse Archers if ther are any Bulgar noble cavalry in the army.. Superior Shooters. units.name: Slav Nobles
units.description: Slav Nobles have javelins and sheild. Skirmishers. May have spear (+1). May have light armour (+1). There must be at least one unit of Slav Cavalery if any Slab Nobl Cavalr are taken. Slav Noble Cavalry May form in Open Order. Up to 25% may be spent on all Slav Cavalry.

units.name: Slav Cavalry
units.description: Slav Nobles have javelins and sheild. Skirmishers. May have spear (+1). There must be at least one unit of Slav Cavalery if any Slab Nobl Cavalr are taken. Slav Noble Cavalry May form in Open Order. Up to 25% may be spent on all Slav Cavalry.

units.name: Slav Warriors
units.description: Slav Warriors have throwing spear and shield. Close order. Warband. May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of six points per base. Every second unitof warriors may replace throwing spar with bow (free). Two formed units of Slav Warrios may replace throwing spear with two-handed axe (free). If armed with throwing spear may have light armour (+2) and large shield (+2).

units.name: Slav Brigands
units.description: Slav Brigands have throwing spear and shield. Open Order. Inferior Fighters. Warband. May be fielded as skirmishers at a cost of four points per base.

units.description: Black Hoods have a bow and shield. Skirmishers. Parthian Shot.

units.name: Varjazi
units.description: Varjazi have light armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. Shieldwall. May be Riding Horses (+1) and may exchange spear for throwing spear (+2), halberd (+2) or two-handed weapon (+2) and javelins(+2).

units.name: Militia
units.description: Militia have a spear and shield. Shieldwall. May have light armour (+2) and javelins (+2). Up to 25% of a unit may exchange spear and shield for bow (free) and forma cobined fomration with teh spearmen.

units.name: Tribal Warriors
units.description: Tribal Warriors have throwing spear, javelins and shield. Warband. Levies. Any Tribal Warrior unit may be designated as Open Order (-4). Tribal Warriors units may be fielded as skirmishers at acost of 7 points per base.

units.name: Smerd Levies
units.description: Smerd Levies have spear and shield. Inferior Fighters. Leveis.

units.name: Rus Skirmishers
units.description: Rus Skirmishers have a bow. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. May exchange bow for javelins and shield (+1). There mmust be at least twice as many formed Militia bases in the army as there are Rus Skirmisher bases.

units.name: Slav Skirmishers
units.description: Slav Skirmishers have a bow. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. May exchange bow for javelins and shield (+1).

units.name: Steppe Archers
units.description: Steppe Archers have a bow. Superior Shooters. Nomad Cavalry. They may have light armour (+1), spear (+1) and shield (+1). They may be fielded as skirmishers.

units.name: Catafractii/Clibanarii
units.description: Catafractii and Clibanarii have cataphract armour. May be Massed Cavalry (+1) May have kontos (+2) and bow (+1). Their horses may have full metal barding (+1). You may have one Catafractii Clibanarii unit for every two Eq units fielde in your army.uites

units.name: Equites
units.description: Equites have a spear, light  armour and shield. Light armour may be exchanged for heavy armour (+1). May have javelins (+1).

units.name: Illyricani Sagittarii
units.description: Equites have javelins and shield. Evade. Inferior Fighters.  They may have spear (+1) and any unit may repalce javelins with bow (free) to become Equites Sagitarri.. These may have light armour (+1) or they may be fielded as skirmishers.

units.name: Legionaries
units.description: Legionaries have a throwing spear, large shield and darts.  Shieldwall. They may have light armour (+2). They may exchange throwing spear for heavy throwing spear (+2). Legionary units may use Combined Formation with a quarter or half of the units figures exchnaging throwing spear, large shield and darts for bow and shield (-4) and forming the rear of thh unit. They may not take any other quipment. Veteran (+2)

units.name: Limitanei
units.description: Legionaries have a spear and large shield.  Inferior Fighters. Shieldwall. The may have darts (+2).

units.name: Auxillia
units.description: Auxillia have a throwing spear, large shield and darts. Open Order. Auxillia units may use Combined Formation with  a quarter or half of the units figures exchanging throwing spear, large shield and darts for bow and shield (-4 for each archer only bases) and forming the rear of the unit. Auxillia may be fielded as skirmishers at a points reduction of 33%.

units.name: Archers
units.description: Archers have bows and shields. Inferior Fighters. Open Order. Every second unit may exchange their bows for sling or javelins (free).

units.name: Heavy Cavalry
units.description: Heavy Cavalry have a spear and shield. Superior Fighters. May have light armour (+1) and javelins (+1).

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have bows. Nomad Cavalry. They may have shield (+1) and spear (+1). The may be fielded as skirmishers. For every two light cavalry units present one foederat Heavy Cavalry unit may be upgraded to Seppe Nobles (+2). Steppe Nobles Have bows.

units.name: Federate Infantry
units.description: Foederati Infantry have a throwing spear and shield. Warband. They may have heavy throwing spear (+2) or javelins(+2).
